availability.statement: Access depends on current Tiingo account entitlements; a 403 means this credential is not entitled to the requested capability.

common_pitfalls: Financial statements are reported quarterly and annually; don't expect daily granularity.
get_daily_fundamentals returns many rows -- use start_date/end_date to limit results.
get_company_meta accepts comma-separated tickers for batch lookups.
description: Company financial statements, daily fundamental metrics, definitions, and company metadata.
workflows: Call get_fundamentals_definitions once to understand available metrics and their types.
Use get_financial_statements for quarterly/annual income, balance sheet, and cash flow data.
Use get_daily_fundamentals for time-series of daily metrics like marketCap and P/E ratio.
Use get_company_meta for sector, industry, country, and SIC code; supports multiple tickers.
